Slap 'em good and run like hell.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
The '''Rapid Response Task Force''' or referred as '''RRTF''', was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] naval [[Task force/Legends|task force]] used in the [[Battle of Mindor]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].

==Composition==
The task force was composed of a variety of [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ships]] and heavier [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], led by the [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser]] [[Justice (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Justice'']]. In the naval force's roster was a [[Bulwark Mark I]], complete with at least three [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] and several landing craft, two [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]], three modified [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] freight liners serving as frigates, and five [[CC-7700 frigate/Legends|CC-7700 interdictor cruisers]], carrying one fighter squadron each.

The force was aided by the new [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruiser]] [[Remember Alderaan (Star Cruiser)|''Remember Alderaan'']], commanded by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], which arrived late at the battle.
